arguments.message:
Yes! You can set up an automatic weekly export to cloud storage.

1. Go to **Settings → Data → Scheduled exports**.
2. Create a new schedule, choose the data you want to export and set the recurrence to **weekly**.
3. Connect your cloud storage provider (Google Drive, Dropbox, etc.) via the OAuth connection.
4. Save the schedule.

Each run will create a new file in the connected destination, and the scheduled‑exports screen will show the history of runs and whether each succeeded.
